name: Urabe Kimimaro
source:
A young fortune teller known as "the Oracle of Shinjuku", who is very popular with women in corporate careers. He is gentle and calm, and bases his day off of what he sees in his crystal ball. His favorite phrase is "He who foretells the future lies, even if he tells the truth". His calm and affable demeanor make him a natural mediator.

[From [url=http://sweet-fuse.com/]official website[/url]]
